summary: Intuitive Machines filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Sales Agreement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $500 million in Class A common stock. The agents include Barclays, Cantor Fitzgerald, and others, with a 3.0% commission. This represents a capital return mechanism via equity issuance, not a special situation. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under an effective S-3 registration statement, not an event-driven corporate action.
